identity.vendor: Excalidraw (open source project / Excalidraw+ commercial offering)

freePlan.limits: Full editor, 1 infinite scene, unlimited collaborators, export to PNG/SVG, local libraries, E2EE, open source

keyLimits.en: 1 infinite scene, unlimited collaborators, PNG/SVG export, integrations with Notion and Obsidian, end-to-end encryption.

Unlimited scenes and folders, cloud storage, access management, edit/view sharing, read-only links and embeds, presentations, extended AI features, comments, team management; annual billing saves about 14%.

capabilities.en: Infinite-canvas whiteboard with a hand-drawn visual style for diagrams and wireframes.
Real-time multiplayer collaboration via shareable links, free even without an account.
Generative AI features: text-to-diagram generation and wireframe-to-code conversion.
Open-source core with a self-hostable codebase and an npm package for embedding the editor.

limitations.en: Free plan is limited to a single infinite scene; multiple saved boards and folders require Excalidraw+.
Cloud storage, access management and team features are exclusive to the paid Excalidraw+ tier.
Advanced professional design features (precise layout tools, complex diagram types) are intentionally limited in favor of its simple, sketch-style focus.

reason.en: Direct competitor for collaborative online whiteboarding.
Direct competitor for lightweight diagramming and collaborative whiteboards.
Overlapping use case for diagramming and quick visual collaboration, though Figma is a full design tool.

missingAlternatives.name: tldraw
missingAlternatives.reason: Direct open-source competitor to Excalidraw's infinite-canvas whiteboard, not in the catalogue.
